subject: prd/feature-brainstorm
statement: When a decision resolves, the skill shall append it to the record before asking the next question, re-reading the record from disk before each write so operator edits made between turns survive.
rationale: batch-captured rulings die with the context window; the record is collaborative
fit_criterion: on every fixture transcript, each ruling appears in the record before the next question turn; a seeded mid-session operator edit persists to the gated record
